measured_problem: The full linear-plus-route mapper fit training coefficients better (relative RMSE 0.146479) but generalized poorly (held-out cosine 0.989966). The nonlinear replacement generalized much better (0.994475) but discarded useful linear structure and fit training coefficients worse (0.201736). The independently proven rank-768 output span remains sufficient.
proposed_method: Factor the solved full linear map through its fixed rank-512 SVD coordinates, retain a linear output from those coordinates, add a SiLU output from the same coordinates, and jointly solve both output matrices before solving the unchanged three route residual maps. The shared projection and two outputs contain exactly the 2359296 values and matrix multiplies of the original full linear map.
material_differences: Preserves a deterministic compressed form of the empirically useful linear solution instead of replacing it with a randomly initialized nonlinear network.
Adds nonlinear correction features through the same fixed rank-512 coordinates, rather than changing hidden width, optimizer, steps, learning rate, seed, loss, or target normalization.
Uses one closed-form joint solve with no iterative optimizer and no hyperparameter sweep.
Keeps coefficient-map stored values and matrix-multiply count exactly equal to the original linear map; only one SiLU and one addition are introduced.
decision: Authorize exactly one separately preregistered no-artifact layer-zero hybrid capacity screen. Any held-out miss closes this hybrid mapper without shared-rank, solver, ridge, feature, data, route, output-rank, attention, layer, or source sweeps.
claim_boundary: Architecture-review authorization only; no fit, extracted model, autonomous quality, runtime, Phase 3, or superiority evidence.
